join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editresponse
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply editresponse <index> <response>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editresponse what okok
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply editresponse <index> <response>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editresponse 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply editresponse <index> <response>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editpattern
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply editpattern <index> <pattern>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editpattern what okok
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply editpattern <index> <pattern>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editpattern 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !autoreply editpattern <index> <pattern>


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editresponse 1 hey
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Autoreply #1 does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editpattern 1 hey
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Autoreply #1 does not exist.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply add who_is_zik Nobody important.
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Autoreply #1 added.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editresponse 1 Somebody.
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Autoreply #1's response has been edited.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Autoreplies: 1: ^who is zik$ -> Somebody.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editpattern 1 REGEX:who.*is.*zik
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Autoreply #1's pattern has been edited.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Autoreplies: 1: who.*is.*zik -> Somebody.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editpattern 1 *
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Error parsing pattern: empty pattern

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editpattern 1 REGEX:*
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Error parsing pattern: missing argument to repetition operator

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!autoreply editresponse 1 (_
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Autoreply #1's response has been edited. Warning: response contains stray (_ or _) separators and may not be processed correctly.
